item.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography in Production
item.description: A software engineering breakdown of NIST-standardized quantum-resistant algorithms: Module Learning with Errors (MLWE), polynomial ring arithmetic, constant-time side-channel resistance, and TLS hybrid migration.
item.author: Hiroshi Tanaka

item.description: Bridging mathematical specification and production software: how temporal logic of actions, refinement mappings, and interactive theorem provers eliminate subtle Byzantine faults.
item.author: Tariq Mahmood

item.description: A programming language theory exploration into linear logic, affine resource tracking, memory consumption guarantees, and safe zero-cost abstractions in compile-time systems.
